core_question: Did the accused personally commit the underlying act?
evidence_needed: Witness testimony, documents, digital evidence, forensic proof

core_question: Did the accused contribute to a collective criminal design?
evidence_needed: Planning records, communications, operational control, coordination evidence
risk_or_pitfall: Overstating association without proving contribution and mental element.

core_question: Did the accused direct, solicit, or induce crimes?
evidence_needed: Orders, speeches, chain-of-command records, timing, compliance evidence
risk_or_pitfall: Confusing inflammatory rhetoric with legally sufficient causation.

core_question: Did assistance have substantial effect with required knowledge or purpose?
evidence_needed: Logistics, financing, intelligence, weapons, access, operational support
risk_or_pitfall: Ignoring mens rea variation across tribunals and statutes.

core_question: Did superior know or should have known and fail to prevent or punish?
evidence_needed: Hierarchy, effective control, notice, reporting channels, disciplinary capacity
risk_or_pitfall: Assuming rank alone establishes effective control.
